blocks.text: MIAMI — Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games. Adebayo finished with 15 rebounds and 12 assists, his ninth career triple-double in regular season play. He’s also had one in the postseason. Nikola Jović scored 15 and Davion Mitchell added 14 for Miami, which had seven players in double figures.
